🎵 Add Real Animal Recordings

Choose MP3, WAV or OGG clips saved on your laptop. These will replace the existing real recordings. Then click Save Offline Presentation to create a self-contained HTML with your audio embedded.

Use short clips (1–5 seconds) to keep the file small. No audio files are uploaded anywhere.
